Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 08/29/2026
Patient: Salvatore Mosciski, 76 y/o M

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 08/24/2026 after a fall from standing height. No radicular symptoms reported. No bowel or bladder dysfunction.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinal muscles. No step-offs or deformities palpated. Neurologic exam intact, strength 5/5 in lower extremities, sensation preserved.

Assessment: Acute back pain post-fall. No red flags for emergent pathology.

Plan: Conservative mgmt with NSAIDs, activity modification, and close follow-up. Advise return if worsening or new neurologic symptoms.

No imaging ordered at this time.

notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/15/2026
Patient: Salvatore Mosciski, 76 y/o M

Exam: MRI thoracic spine

Findings: MRI 09/15/2026: T12 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. No other acute fractures identified. Adjacent vertebrae appear intact. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement noted. Spinal canal and neural foramina patent without significant stenosis.

Impression: T12 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury. No additional acute abnormalities detected.

notes.text:
Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/27/2026
Patient: Salvatore Mosciski, 76 y/o M

HPI: Outpt, not admitted. NRS 8/10 despite 4 wks NSM (acetaminophen and tramadol, TLSO brace). Pain worse x2 wks despite brace. Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Plan: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program. Consider interventional options if pain persists or worsens.

No signs of infection or systemic illness. Continue current meds and brace use. Monitor closely.
